title: The same software does not imply the same readiness
text: The supplied scenarios contrast companies using similar systems but having different process clarity and decision discipline. This gives a practical reason to check local workflow maturity before copying another implementation, even when both businesses use the same customer-management platform.
qualification: Scenarios illustrate a mechanism; they are not a controlled study of causes of success.
